integrity: The result distinguishes original wheel dihedral characters from the previously published nonequivariant wedge type. Verification uses exact arithmetic and standard-library code; no independent review performed.
scientific_limitations: Integral representation lattice, equivariant homotopy, and definitive publication priority are not established; 2011 first public cyclic independence foundation, 2019 separate nonequivariant wheel theorem.
title: Dihedral homology characters of ordinary wheel matching complexes
